title: Nested array mixed with a scalar - the documented output does not exist
rationale: This exact document appears in the MapFlattener class javadoc, which claims the output is {data_name, data_value}. Both halves of that claim are false: the sentinel maps to the base key "data", not "data_value", and the null padding described does not exist on this path. A fixture whose value is that it contradicts the shipped documentation.
catchesBugClass: Two classes at once: documentation that describes a padding control that was never implemented, and the leaf-versus-branch key collision in setNestedValue where a one-segment key silently clobbers a subtree built from a longer key sharing its name.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the reverse collision order (subtree written after the leaf), which takes the _value-wrapper branch and fails differently. It also cannot tell whether the javadoc or the code is the intended behaviour; a human must classify that, and the fix must not be to edit the javadoc to match the code.

predicted.detail: Actual flatten output uses the base key "data" rather than the documented data_value, and there is no positional null padding, so index alignment is already destroyed before reconstruction.
